name: Baseten
short: Baseten's inference platform — pre-optimized Model APIs plus dedicated GPU deployments with per-minute billing.

plans.name: Basic (Free Signup Trial)
plans.notes: Instant API key with $30 trial credits on signup to test OpenAI-compatible serverless Model APIs (DeepSeek, GLM, Beam) and scale-to-zero deployments locally with no monthly platform fee.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Priority GPU access, dedicated compute, higher Model API rate limits, Slack/Zoom support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom SLAs, self-hosted or hybrid deployment, data residency and advanced RBAC.

plans.name: Model APIs
